versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_msdt.yml
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
  ParentImage|endswith: '\WINWORD.exe'
  Image|endswith: '\msdt.exe'
selection_cmd:
  Image|endswith: '\msdt.exe'
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - 'ms-msdt:/id'
    - 'IT_BrowseForFile='
    - 'IT_RebrowseForFile='
condition: 1 of selection*
